Proposals.Development: The party successfully neutralized the goblin guard at the upper level entrance and secured the exit route by forcing the goblin leader, Skrit Ironjaw, to surrender his command structure. They located the captives (Nella and Hobb) in the storage chamber, assessed their injuries, and began the retreat with the group intact.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: The party has secured the captives and neutralized the goblin defenses. They are now managing the physical toll of carrying the injured (Torin's shoulder strain, Maren's injury, Kaelen's depleted magic) while navigating the exit route back to the village.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: The party returns to the village with the captives and receives the reward.
